title: Session Cost Stabilizer — product brief & launch playbook
author: Sofia Chen
content:
Overview:

This document describes the Session Cost Stabilizer (SCS): a product initiative and launch playbook that reduces per-session cost variance while preserving latency and fidelity SLOs. SCS is an adaptive runtime + policy layer in Redwood Optimize that monitors live session characteristics, predicts imminent cost spikes, and applies targeted, reversible interventions (prefetch, batching window adjustment, adaptive quantization hinting, or fidelity gating) to keep session-level token expenditure within configured bands.

Intended audience:
- Product managers and program leads
- Runtime engineers and platform owners
- Developer experience and pricing teams
- Customer success and sales for enterprise onboarding

Problem statement:
Many customers report unpredictable per-session costs driven by bursts (long conversations, multimodal requests, or large context windows). This variability complicates SLO-backed pricing, makes capacity planning noisy for Dedicated, and increases billing disputes. Existing tools (cost dashboards, static batching) surface the problem but do not proactively stabilize customer economics in-production.

Goals and success metrics (90-day & 12-month):
1) Reduce median per-session cost variance (coefficient of variation) by 35% for early adopters within 90 days of rollout.
2) Reduce 95th-percentile per-session token spend by 25% without increasing end-to-end latency p95 by more than 10% relative to baseline.
3) Decrease influx of billing disputes related to session spikes by 50% for instrumented accounts.
4) Achieve <1% false-positive rate for fidelity-reduction interventions (measured by eval promptset regressions).

Scope (what SCS will and will not do):
In scope:
- Live adaptive policy layer integrated with Optimize and the serving runtime.
- Console controls for per-tenant session caps, stabilizer aggressiveness, and reporting.
- Telemetry and audit logs for interventions and cost delta attribution.
- Canary and canary-to-account rollout tooling.

Out of scope (initial release):
- Billing engine changes (only reporting hooks; billing changes in v2).
- Private on-prem packaged agent (v1 is hosted+Dedicates).
- Developer SDK instrumentation (planned v2 SDK).

User journeys and personas:
- Platform engineer (Dedicated): sets a per-route session budget, chooses Stabilizer profile (conservative/aggressive), and schedules canary rollout.
- Product developer: receives Console alerts about session-exceed patterns and uses the preflight simulator to replay sessions and tune presets.
- Customer success manager: reviews the Stabilizer report with an enterprise customer and proposes a migration from ad-hoc warm capacity to stabilized routing.

Requirements (MUST / SHOULD / MAY):
MUST:
- RQ-001: SCS exposes a runtime REST contract for intervention decisions: POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/stabilize -> returns action (none | throttle | quant_hint | batch_hint | degrade_fidelity).
- RQ-002: All interventions are reversible and logged with audit metadata (owner, timestamp, reason, cost_estimate_delta).
- RQ-003: Console and API provide per-tenant aggressiveness (0.0–1.0), session budget (tokens), and exemption lists.
- RQ-004: Telemetry emitted for each session: session_id, tenant_id, action, pre_tokens, post_tokens_estimate, latency_delta_estimate.

SHOULD:
- RQ-005: Integrate with Optimize suggestion engine to propose default profiles based on historical workload clusters.
- RQ-006: Provide preflight simulator to run sampled replay of sessions and estimate stabilized economic impact.

MAY:
- RQ-007: Export granular billing-reconciliation reports for v2 billing integration.
- RQ-008: Provide a self-serve SDK hook for local simulation.

API contract (example):
{
  "method": "POST",
  "path": "/v1/sessions/abc123/stabilize",
  "body": {
    "tenant_id": "t-0a1b2c",
    "route": "chat-generic",
    "history_tokens": 1420,
    "expected_future_tokens": 2800,
    "latency_slo_ms": 750
  }
}

Response example:
{
  "action": "quant_hint",
  "params": {"target_quant": "int8", "expected_token_reduction_pct": 32},
  "reason": "predicted-future-spike-model-v2::0.87",
  "ttl_seconds": 90
}

Console changes and UX: (high level)
- New 'Session Stabilizer' section in Optimize -> Operations.
- Preset gallery: conservative / balanced / aggressive with inline simulations.
- Per-tenant timeline view showing actions, cost delta, and links to request traces (trace IDs link to Trace Explorer).

Telemetry, observability, and SLOs:
- Telemetry schema: session.stabilizer.action, session.stabilizer.reason, session.stabilizer.pre_tokens, session.stabilizer.post_tokens_est, session.stabilizer.latency_impact_ms.
- SLOs: intervention decision latency must be < 30ms p95.
- Integration: each action emits a CDC event to the cost-attribution pipeline (topic: cost.stabilizer.actions).
- Monitoring: Alert when false-positive rate (detected regressions / total interventions) > 1% for any tenant over a 7-day window.

Telemetry retention and dashboards:
- 90-day raw storage for cost attribution; 1-year aggregated rollups (per-tenant weekly).
- Dashboards: Stabilizer Overview (adoption, cost-savings), Fidelity Regression Heatmap (promptset-level), Intervention Latency and Success Rate.

Pricing and packaging notes (impact guidance):
- v1 ships as part of the Optimize enterprise add-on. Default offering: inclusion for Dedicated customers with Enterprise tier; self-serve upsell for Hosted customers.
- Pricing approach: feature gating with a per-tenant monthly stabilization quota measured in 'stabilizer-actions' (soft quota for first 90 days).
- Commercial guidance for sales: highlight reduction in billing disputes, predictable per-session economics for SLO-backed contracts, and trials with a 30-day action quota.
- Expected revenue motion: conservative uplift during first 12 months; primary value prop is retention and SLA migration from hosted to Dedicated.

Rollout plan and milestones (draft timeline):
Phase 0 — Prototype & lab validation (May 2026)
- Implement decision API and a testback that simulates common spike patterns.
- Run A/B simulation against historical traces.

Phase 1 — Internal canary (June 2026)
- Deploy stabilizer to staging + internal beta tenants.
- Validate telemetry, decision latency, and false-positive metrics.

Phase 2 — Opt-in customers (July–Sep 2026)
- Invite 10 customers (mix of startups and enterprise) to opt-in.
- Weekly review with CSMs; adjust presets.

Phase 3 — Broad availability and packaging (Q4 2026)
- GA launch; console promotes preset gallery; pricing SKU published.
- Publish migration playbook for Dedicated customers.

Detailed rollout steps (per-customer canary):
1) Obtain tenant opt-in and set 'stabilizer.profile' to conservative.
2) Run preflight simulation and share report with customer.
3) Enable live interventions for a 24–72 hour monitoring window.
4) Meet with CSM to tune profile or schedule rollback if fidelity regressions occur.

Ownership and dependencies:
- Product owner: Sofia Chen (product).
- Runtime lead: Miguel Torres (eng-serving-runtime).
- Optimize integration: Priya Desai (eng-platform).
- Console UX: Daniel Park (eng-developer-experience).
- Billing: Liaison only for v2 (finance-and-legal).
- Dependencies: decision model (research), cost attribution pipeline (eng-platform), Trace Explorer links (eng-sre).

Implementation risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Fidelity regressions after aggressive interventions. Mitigation: conservative default, shadow testing with shadow interventions, and promptset regression harness to block rollouts.
- Risk: Decision latency increases tail latency. Mitigation: keep decision path on hot path <30ms, provide async fallback to no-op if decision exceeds threshold.
- Risk: Customer confusion about observed cost deltas. Mitigation: rich audit logs, preflight simulator, and CSM playbook for onboarding.

Launch checklist (pre-GA):
- [ ] Decision API stable and perf-tested (p95 < 30ms).
- [ ] Preflight simulator available in Console.
- [ ] Preset gallery with at least 3 validated profiles and docs.
- [ ] Telemetry pipelines and dashboards live.
- [ ] Legal and pricing brief for commercial team.
- [ ] Beta customers onboarded and 90-day impact validated.

Open questions and next steps:
- Q1: What is the long-term billing model (action-based vs. savings-share)? Target decision: action-based for v2.
- Q2: Should private on-prem agent be a supported SKU at GA? Recommend deferred to v2 after hosted feedback.
- Q3: How to integrate SCS with per-route SLO-weighting and contract-level fidelity buckets? Action: cross-team design session (Product + Legal + Eng-platform).

Appendix: example preflight simulator CLI
redwood optimize simulate-stabilizer --tenant t-0a1b2c --preset balanced --sample 100 --from 2026-01-01 --to 2026-04-01 --output report.csv
